Future Work/Recommendations I would suggest future analysis of potential bimodal operation of our electrocaloric thin films containing LCs. I also believe there could be value in exploring other LCs with electrocaloric behavior and possibly tethering these LC covalently to electrocaloric polymers. This would prevent the loss of LC by leaching during operation. Such a synthesis process would require a longer-term effort. We also believe that we could apply these films to a heat exchange surface and demonstrate cooling on a larger scale. 9. Products Publications: Ruan, W., Ritchey, Z., Wang, F., Huey, B.
